zh: 外观设置页的吉祥物项改为标题行开关与三张角色预览卡片（Clawd、Deepy、鲸娘），关闭时收起卡片，跟随主题时在对应卡片下标出「跟随主题显示」，手动固定角色后显示「恢复跟随主题」按钮
en: Replace the Mascot segmented control in Appearance settings with a header switch and three character preview cards (Crab, Deepy, Whale Girl); turning it off collapses the cards, following the theme marks the active brand's character as Following theme, and pinning a character offers a Follow theme again button
